in_sanskrit.name: Mallick
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है God of Death
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Mallick एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। In Hindu mythology, Mallick is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Mahalaspa’, meaning ‘the great lord of death’. The god Yama, who is responsible for the administration of death, is often referred to as Mallick. This name carries a deep sense of spiritual significance and is believed to bring a sense of control and calmness to the bearer.
